name: tradstry-projector
description: Y.Doc CRDT -> Lexical document_json projector (invoked as a short-lived subprocess by the Rust backend)

scripts.sync-core: bun build ../../packages/notebook-core/src/index.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile notebook-core.gen.mjs --external lexical --external '@lexical/*' --external yjs && bun build ../../packages/notebook-core/src/seed.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile notebook-seed.gen.mjs --external lexical --external '@lexical/*' --external yjs
